slides.say: You submit a form and the whole page reloads. That is the browser’s default behavior.
Call e dot prevent default on the event to stop the browser’s default action. Now there is no reload.

slides.text:
preventDefault: stops the browser’s default action.
stopPropagation: stops parent handlers.
slides.say: Do not confuse the two. Prevent default stops the browser’s built in behavior. Stop propagation stops handlers on the tags above.

slides.text: They are unrelated. Use one, the other, or both.
slides.say: They are unrelated, and both are useful. Use whichever one solves your problem.
